Improved weighted forecast error on the four pilot customers from 24.5 % to 17.8 % on the frozen Q3 holdout set against the documented version 1.4 baseline.
Coordinated release decisions in the forecasting release meeting; the forecasting lead took the release decision and customer operations confirmed the rollout to each pilot customer.
